definition_en: Taking the ordered quantity of a material from a storage container and putting it into the order container.
notes: Also the name of the WMS application/mode.

definition_en: Verb for performing order picking.
One pick of one order line.
A customer or internal request listing materials and quantities.
Container that receives the picked material (the target box in the app).
notes: The container the trainee fills in VR.

definition_en: Container the material is taken from (the source).
Quantity that has to be picked for the order line.
notes: Shown on the WMS screen as the label Soll.

definition_en: WMS field label for the target quantity.
notes: Keep the German label in every language mode; EN mode may show the gloss in brackets.

definition_en: Quantity actually picked; when counting by hand it is pre-filled with the target quantity.
WMS field label for the actual quantity.
Stock left in the storage container after the pick; NOT the quantity still missing.
notes: BasicPickingScene shows Rest as static remaining stock since #34 (B6).

definition_en: WMS field label for the remaining stock.
Counting the stock left in the storage container (F9) to confirm it.
notes: Also a WMS indicator label.

definition_en: Confirmed quantity when actual is less than target.
Number of pieces in one carton or bag.
notes: Abbreviation VPE. A quantity, not the name of the physical package: for the object use Karton or Tüte.

definition_en: Abbreviation of Verpackungseinheit.
notes: Keep the abbreviation in both languages.

definition_en: WMS field label (abbreviation of Verpackungseinheit).

Class (0, 2–6, 8, 9) that states how a material may be picked: loose bulk (0, 2), placed one by one in order (3), touching in one/two/no layer with separators (4/5/6), ESD-protected (8), special packaging (9; 8 and 9 not without instructions).
notes: Full German form not stated in the documents – ask. Classes 1 and 7 do not exist in the table.

definition_en: WMS field label; meaning not stated in the documents.
notes: Probably shows the EKZ class – question B3.

definition_en: Unit of count.
notes: Abbreviation ST on the WMS screen.

definition_en: Unit abbreviation for Stück on the WMS screen.
Cardboard box.
notes: Also a WMS field label.

definition_en: Plastic bag used to pack loose material.
notes: Documents also write PE-Beutel – confirm which term to use.

definition_en: Insert/container used to pre-pack material inside the order container.
Loose parts that may be poured.
Quantity left over when a packaging unit is opened for a partial pick.
Order that refills stock; marked light blue at the bottom left of the WMS screen.
Separating identical-looking packs (from 8 pieces) with a bag or module.
Counting scale used from 8 pieces with low weight.
notes: Also a WMS indicator label.

definition_en: Scale used from 700 g.
notes: Also a WMS indicator label.

definition_en: Counting by hand (up to 7 pieces).
notes: Also a WMS indicator label.

definition_en: Setting the scale to zero with the container on it.
notes: Also a WMS indicator and F7 button.

definition_en: Printed sticker (pick label) for a bag or position.
Confirming a pick or a message.
notes: Confirm key depends on the dialog: new dialog (TMA/CSC4) F6 Bestätigen or foot pedal, old dialog (KOM 1/2) F12 Bestätigen. In the new dialog F12 is Aufkl. korr. Which dialog the app uses: question B8.

definition_en: Person to inform on deviations.
Identifier of a material.
notes: WMS label Mat.-Nr:

definition_en: Material description text.
notes: WMS label Bez.:

definition_en: Weight in kg.
notes: WMS label Gew.:

definition_en: Special handling instruction shown at the bottom right of the WMS screen.
Package type used in the app; meaning not yet confirmed.
notes: Question A2. Not found in any requirement document.

definition_en: Bag in which several pieces are pre-packed by the supplier (e.g. 10er Tüte).
notes: Documents also write Beutel (10er Beutel).

definition_en: Cardboard packaging of pre-packed material.
notes: Use Karton for one box.

definition_en: Product packaging box.
The goods of an order line (identified by Materialnummer), whatever their packaging.
notes: Used in feedback such as complex.feedback.wrong_package.

definition_en: Material that is not pre-packed and is picked piece by piece.
notes: Use for loose items; the unit is Stück (ST). The documents use neither Paket, Packstück nor Gebinde.

definition_en: Short identifier of a participant, P plus three digits (e.g. P017), typed on the keypad.
notes: Used as 'Code eingeben', 'Code: P017'.

definition_en: One run of the app by one participant, recorded by the research logger.
notes: Used in entry.warning.finished and entry.error.start.

definition_en: State for test codes (P000, P900-P999) whose data is not analysed.
The whole training sequence of five lessons.
notes: Course leader = Kursleitung.

definition_en: Lesson name, WelcomeScene.
Lesson name, ConceptScene.
Lesson name, BasicPickingScene.
notes: EKZ stays untranslated.

definition_en: Lesson name, MixedPickingScene.
Lesson name, ComplexScene.
